technique_name: Propose a procedure for presenting a report.
description: The first step of presenting a report is to prepare the materials that will be associated with the presentation. This includes organizing the content of the report, visual aids, and other resources. Once prepared, rehearse the presentation to ensure clarity and accuracy. It is also important to practice with any audio/visual components that will be used during the presentation.
